svg.title: pakr v0.6.2: Pack and unpack speeds
svg.desc: Native and pakr compared across 12 formats on Linux source and WARC data.

g.text: Speed = native time / pakr time, median of six pairs. Above 1x favors pakr; below 1x favors native.
Dot: median speed. Whisker: observed min to max. Times: median seconds, pakr / native.
Many small files; full tree for archives, deterministic TAR for codecs.
